rawPayload.Product_Description_Legacy: With 9.0 cubic feet of capacity, this dryer from LG can accommodate huge loads of laundry while offering superb drying performance. With the power of LG's Sensor Dry technology, this dryer senses the needs of each load, measuring the moisture and humidity levels during the cycle and automatically adjusting the drying time. The power of TrueSteam technology helps fight against wrinkling, stains and odors for outstandingly crisp, clean laundry. Reduce the need for ironing and get ready-to-wear garments right out of the dryer. Plus, LG's LoDecibel Quiet Operation technology ensures that your dryer runs quietly, for a non-disruptive laundry routine. Get outstanding capacity, convenience and drying power with this TrueSteam dryer from LG.
rawPayload.Features_Legacy:
• 9.0 cu.ft. Capacity: Towers of towels, piles of sweatshirts, and a mountain of jeans-go for it. The ultra large capacity (9.0 cu. ft.) dryer lets you do more laundry in fewer loads. That's time saved and sore backs avoided.
  • 14 Drying Programs: Cotton/Normal, Perm Press, Towels, Delicates, Heavy Duty, SteamFresh, SteamSanitary, Anti-Bacterial, Jumbo Dry, Wool, Super Dry, SpotClean, Speed Dry, Air Dry.
  • TrueSteam Technology: Generates real steam to reduce wrinkles, stains and odors, and practically eliminates the need for ironing.
  • Wrinkle Care: Ensures that your clothes are ready to wear straight out of the dryer.
  • Sensor Dry: LG's Sensor Dry system measures the moisture and humidity levels during the cycle and automatically adjusts the drying time, to ensure you get dry laundry every time.
  • LoDecibel Quiet Operation: Keeps your LG unit running quietly - do your laundry without the noise.
  • Reversible Door: To accommodate either right or left-handed users for maximum convenience.
